name: sendAppointmentWebhook
shortDescription: Sends a webhook notification to external systems upon changes to an Appointment record.
description:
Overview

Notifies external systems about significant events related to Appointment records (creation, updates, deletion) via configurable webhooks.

Intended use

Invoked as an event handler whenever an Appointment record is created, updated, or deleted. It receives the relevant Appointment data.

Logic

  1. Construct a payload containing relevant Appointment data (e.g., ID, status, date, patient/doctor IDs) and the event type (e.g., 'appointment.created', 'appointment.updated', 'appointment.deleted').
  2. Call the Webhook external service using ctx.service('Webhook').send to dispatch the notification to configured endpoints.
  3. Log the webhook delivery attempt and status (success/failure) using ctx.audit.log.

Entities

  • Appointment

External Services

  • Webhook
